intro: The Bottom of Gelkak's Key is one of three fragments of a shattered mechanical winding key belonging to the shipwrecked gnome pirate Gelkak Gyromast. After his vessel foundered off Darkshore, the piece was scavenged by the shoreline's native reef crawlers.

p: When Gelkak Gyromast's ship was sunk by threshadons off the coast of Darkshore, the gnome was thrown ashore along with his belongings. Among his most prized possessions was the winding key used to activate his mechanical first mate. The key shattered on the coastal rocks into three distinct pieces, and local scavengers immediately descended upon the debris. The bottom piece of the key was snatched up by the aggressive crustaceans wandering the surf—specifically the reef and tide crawlers that pick through the detritus along the tideline.
